title: Sustainability in Private Markets, 2026: As Progress Continues, AI Poses New Risks and Opportunities
gist: BCG and the ESG Data Convergence Initiative report from nearly 10,000 private portfolio companies that private-market decarbonization is advancing faster than in public companies and GPs report higher revenue and lower costs from it. The new risk is governance: many private companies lack cyber and AI oversight, while AI is also pegged at about $600B of annual sustainability-sector value by 2028 and reshaping up to 55% of US jobs.

insights.claim: Private portfolio companies are increasingly setting decarbonization strategies, and their Scope 1 and 2 emissions intensity is falling materially faster than at public companies.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Private ownership may be a faster lever for emissions cuts than public-market engagement; supports PE-led transition narratives.
insights.quote: The number of private companies establishing decarbonization strategies has risen, while their Scopes 1 and 2 emissions intensity continues to decline at materially faster rates than for public companies.

insights.claim: GPs report that sustainability efforts produce both higher revenues and lower costs at portfolio companies, framing sustainability as a value-creation lever rather than a compliance cost.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Self-reported by GPs in a BCG-administered dataset, so treat as directional; useful for ESG-as-alpha pitches to LPs.

insights.claim: The EDCI benchmark now covers 300 GPs and almost 10,000 portfolio companies, with combined Scope 1 and 2 emissions equal to the entire UK and a workforce the size of Australia's.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: The dataset is large enough to become a de facto standard for private-market sustainability reporting and LP due diligence.
insights.quote: Its portfolio companies have a combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions footprint equivalent to the entire UK.
insights.locator: The EDCI's role in the private markets

insights.claim: EDCI added a cybersecurity metric this year, signaling that cyber is moving into core standardized portfolio reporting for private capital.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Expect LPs to start asking GPs for cyber metrics in DDQs.
insights.quote: This year, the initiative added a new cybersecurity metric
insights.locator: The EDCI's role in the private markets

insights.claim: BCG estimates AI could generate around $600 billion of global annual value by 2028 in established sustainability sectors, via lower emissions, less waste and efficiency gains.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Offsets the narrative that AI compute is purely an emissions negative; a point for AI-enabled climate/efficiency plays.
insights.quote: we also estimate that AI could generate around $600 billion in global annual value by 2028 in established sustainability sectors

insights.claim: Attention on AI's emissions externalities from rising compute demand may be overweighting the cost side relative to AI's potential environmental benefits.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Implied rather than argued; worth testing against data-center power demand forecasts.

insights.claim: Up to 55% of US jobs will be meaningfully reshaped by AI, with significant changes to how employees work across roles.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Reshaped is not eliminated; implies large reskilling and productivity effects rather than pure displacement.
insights.quote: up to 55% of US jobs will be meaningfully reshaped by the new technology

themes.theme: Governance gap in AI and cyber

insights.claim: A significant proportion of private companies have not yet prepared for growing cybersecurity risks or set up governance mechanisms to oversee safe and effective AI adoption.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Unmitigated governance gaps are latent portfolio risk and a potential source of value leakage at PE-owned companies.
insights.quote: a significant proportion of private companies have not yet made the preparations necessary to protect themselves from a growing range of cybersecurity risks
insights.locator: And then there is AI's impact on governance

insights.claim: Private companies and their owning funds that respond effectively to cyber and AI governance risks will be better positioned to protect and grow value.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Governance quality could become a differentiator in exit valuations and fund performance.
insights.quote: Private companies, and the investment funds that own them, that effectively respond to these growing risks will be those that are better positioned to protect and grow value.
insights.locator: And then there is AI's impact on governance

insights.claim: AI adoption is accelerating across the private markets and touches every aspect of sustainability: environmental, social and governance.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: AI is now an ESG-wide factor, so sustainability diligence frameworks need an AI layer.
insights.quote: Adoption of this transformative technology is accelerating across the private markets and impacting every aspect of sustainability.
